mapper.sql: r.id, r.order_id AS orderId, r.homestay_id AS homestayId, r.tenant_id AS tenantId, r.rating, r.content, r.images AS imagesRaw, r.reply, r.reply_at AS replyAt, r.created_at AS createdAt, su.real_name AS tenantName, su.avatar AS tenantAvatar, h.title AS homestayTitle, h.city AS city, o.order_no AS orderNo
FROM review r INNER JOIN homestay h ON h.id = r.homestay_id INNER JOIN booking_order o ON o.id = r.order_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = r.tenant_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
AND r.homestay_id = #{query.homestayId}
AND (h.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR su.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
